job.title: Procurement Specialist
job.description:
We are seeking an experienced Procurement professional to join our clients' Procurement Services team in Invercargill.

This is a broad and commercially focused procurement role where you will work closely with stakeholders to deliver effective procurement outcomes.
You will lead and support end-to-end tender processes, provide commercial advice, and manage supplier and contract relationships in line with procurement policies and best practice.

You will be involved in:
  • Leading tenders, evaluations, negotiations and contract awards.
  • Developing procurement plans, business cases and procurement strategies.
  • Providing commercial and procurement advice to operational leaders and stakeholders.
  • Managing contract reviews, performance, risks and supplier relationships.
  • Supporting and mentoring colleagues across the procurement function.
  • Building strong relationships with suppliers, contractors and external stakeholders.
You will ideally have:
  • 5+ years' procurement experience, with strong exposure to tenders, evaluations, negotiations and contract management.
  • Strong knowledge of government procurement processes, systems, policies and best practice.
  • Experience developing procurement documentation and tender reports.
  • Excellent analytical, written, presentation and negotiation skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple projects, priorities and deadlines.
  • Experience within local or central government would be advantageous, as would MCIPS or other relevant professional qualifications.
If you're a commercially minded procurement professional who enjoys working with stakeholders and wants to make a tangible impact, we'd like to hear from you. Please send CV to brad@alexanderjames.co.nz

job.title: Head of Tax and Treasury
job.description:
This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Tax & Treasury leader to take ownership of a broad international remit within a successful New Zealand head office business.

Reporting directly to the CFO and with Board exposure, this is a highly visible role for someone who combines strong technical expertise with commercial curiosity. You’ll be someone who naturally asks, “why are we doing it this way?”, identifies opportunities to improve, and has the confidence and capability to make change happen.

You’ll lead the Group’s tax and treasury function, with a particular focus on improving how the business manages cash across multiple jurisdictions. This includes reviewing banking arrangements, optimising cash and liquidity, securing competitive interest rates, and ensuring the business is taking a proactive rather than reactive approach.

You’ll also take ownership of the Group’s tax requirements, while reviewing and developing policies, processes and controls to improve efficiency, governance, and visibility.

Key responsibilities include:
  • Leading tax and treasury across a complex international business
  • Optimising cash, liquidity, banking arrangements and interest rates
  • Improving cash visibility and forecasting across the Group
  • Developing and improving tax and treasury policies and processes
  • Managing banking, tax adviser and other external relationships
  • Providing commercial advice to the CFO, leadership team and Board
  • Identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, controls and ways of working
You’ll be an experienced tax and treasury professional who can build credibility quickly and operate confidently with senior stakeholders.

Technically strong, commercially minded, and naturally inquisitive, you’ll want to understand how things work and, importantly, how they could work better.
You’ll bring strong tax and treasury expertise, ideally within a complex or international environment, along with experience in cash management, banking relationships, policy development, and process improvement.

This is an opportunity to have genuine influence, working closely with the CFO and Board to shape and strengthen the tax and treasury function of an international organisation.
 
Please apply online with your up to date CV and contact details to Kim Hawkes.

job.title: Senior Underwriter
job.description:
An established New Zealand life insurer is seeking an experienced Senior Underwriter to join its highly regarded underwriting team.

This position will see you manage complex life, trauma, disability and income-protection applications while building trusted relationships with financial advisers. You will use strong risk assessment and commercial judgement to find appropriate solutions for customers within agreed underwriting guidelines.

Key Responsibilities:

Reporting to an experienced Underwriting Manager, you will:
  • Assess complex life, trauma, total and permanent disability and income-protection applications
  • Make quality underwriting decisions within your delegated authority
  • Balance effective risk management with commercial and customer considerations
  • Communicate application outcomes clearly to advisers and customers
  • Work with reinsurers and medical specialists on complex or higher-value cases
  • Develop strong relationships across key adviser networks
  • Help progress pending applications within agreed service standards
  • Support junior underwriters through coaching and guidance
  • Contribute to training, process improvements and overall team performance
Key Requirements:
  • At least three years’ senior-level life-insurance underwriting experience
  • Strong experience across life, trauma, disability and income-protection products
  • Strong knowledge of medical terminology, conditions, treatments and prognosis
  • The ability to interpret financial information when assessing income-protection and business-related applications
  • Sound commercial judgement and the ability to identify solutions within appropriate risk parameters
  • Excellent adviser and customer relationship skills
  • A collaborative approach and willingness to assist the wider team
  • An ALUCA or other relevant insurance qualification would be advantageous but is not essential.
If you are an experienced life underwriter who combines technical expertise with commercial thinking and excellent relationship skills, we would be pleased to hear from you.

Apply now or send your CV and cover letter to mel@alexanderjames.co.nz

job.title: Digital and Marketing Coordinator
job.description:
Operating across the globe in more than 40 countries, this organisation enables healthy living conditions and are leaders in their field. Their mission is to ensure that all buildings are healthy, energy efficient and friendly to the environment. This team work hard but love a laugh and big believers in helping each other out.

Based in Petone, this is a varied, hands-on digital and marketing coordination role where you will play a key part in bringing this brand to life across digital channels, events and customer engagement. Alongside the National Marketing Manager, Sales team, and external partners, you will create compelling content, manage social media campaigns, support events and ensure our marketing activities are delivered to a consistently high standard.

Key responsibilities include:
  • Managing and optimising paid and organic social media campaigns across Meta, LinkedIn and YouTube
  • Creating engaging social media content, copy and short-form video that strengthens the brand
  • Planning and maintaining the social media content calendar while fostering online community engagement
  • Supporting website updates through CMS and WordPress
  • Assisting with the coordination and delivery of events, seminars, trade shows, and product launches across New Zealand
  • Providing administrative support to the Marketing and Sales teams and collaborating across the wider business to ensure consistent branding and messaging
  • Some morning/evening events and travel may involved (approx. a few days, four times a year)
About you and the experience you can bring:
  • You will be a proactive, creative, and organised marketing professional who enjoys working across a broad range of activities
  • Strong content creation and copywriting skills, with an eye for engaging digital content
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the confidence to work with internal teams, customers, and external partners
  • A proactive approach, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to juggle multiple priorities
  • A positive, collaborative attitude and a genuine passion for delivering exceptional marketing outcomes
  • Proficiency in Adobe CS, Canva, Mailchimp, and strong computing skills in general
If you have additional questions that may not be answered above, you're welcome to contact Sally Stanton on 021563311

job.title: ICT - Procurement Category Manager
job.description:
As a Procurement Category Manager, you will be at the forefront of category leadership, supplier engagement and strategic procurement initiatives. Your ability to negotiate, influence, and deliver commercially beneficial outcomes will be key to success in this role.

Key Responsibilities: 

Supplier & Stakeholder Engagement – Build and maintain strong supplier relationships to ensure best in market agreements and strategic partnerships.
Commercial Negotiation – Develop unique commercial propositions, leveraging group volumes to enhance market position.
Category Management – Conduct data-driven analysis to identify growth opportunities and improve outcomes.
Contract & Performance Management – Negotiate and manage supplier contracts while assessing ongoing performance to ensure alignment with business objectives.

About You:
  • Proven experience in IT procurement category management or supplier relations. Open to industry experience
  • Strong commercial acumen and negotiation skills with the ability to influence at operational and executive levels.
  • Ability to develop and execute procurement strategies that drive profitability and market share.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • A results driven, self motivated professional who thrives in a dynamic and fast paced environment.
How to Apply:

If you're ready to grow your career in a high performing Procurement team, apply now! Submit your CV and a brief cover letter highlighting your relevant experience.
Email brad@alexanderjames.co.nz for further information.

job.title: Finance Manager - S/4HANA Finance Lead
job.description:
Join a large, complex and asset-intensive organisation as it undertakes a significant SAP S/4HANA implementation.

The role
Representing Financial Control, you will help ensure the new system is designed, tested and implemented with robust accounting processes, reporting and controls. The project is currently entering the design phase, with an initial migration from SAP ECC to S/4HANA followed by a broader transformation programme.
This is a dedicated project position with no BAU accounting responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Represent Financial Control throughout the S/4HANA implementation
  • Lead the finance input into fixed assets and project accounting
  • Review general ledger, reporting, master data and process design
  • Ensure sound financial controls and governance are embedded in the new system
  • Support solution design, data migration, testing, cutover and go-live
  • Identify accounting, reporting and control risks and recommend practical solutions
  • Work closely with finance, technology, project, audit and implementation stakeholders
Key Requirements:
  • CA Qualified
  • Hands-on SAP S/4HANA implementation, migration, upgrade or transformation experience - NON-NEGOTIABLE
  • Strong fixed-asset accounting experience, ideally across a large asset base
  • Knowledge of SAP Asset Accounting and capital/project accounting
  • A strong understanding of general ledger, financial reporting and financial controls
  • Experience working in a complex, regulated or asset-intensive organisation
  • The ability to translate accounting requirements into practical system and process solutions
  • Confident stakeholder management and strong documentation skills
This is an excellent opportunity to play a key role in a major finance transformation programme. The initial term is expected to be at least 12 months, with the potential to extend to 18 months or longer. 

Apply now or send your CV and cover letter to mel@alexanderjames.co.nz

job.title: Senior Management Accountant
job.description:
Join a large, purpose-led national organisation where you will support five Regional Directors as their trusted finance contact. You will provide accurate reporting, forward-looking insight and constructive financial advice to help them manage performance and make informed decisions.

Key Responsibilities:

Work alongside Finance Business Partners and the wider finance team, you will:
  • Complete month-end processes, including accruals and journals
  • Deliver monthly financial and operational reporting
  • Manage regional budgets, forecasts, P&Ls and FTE caps
  • Analyse results and clearly explain variances against budgets and targets
  • Provide financial advice on operating and capital expenditure
  • Support financial analysis across a significant portfolio
  • Review the financial impact of business proposals and projects
  • Identify trends, risks and emerging performance issues
  • Improve financial models, dashboards, reporting and forecasting processes
  • Build strong relationships with Regional Directors and budget holders
  • Support and mentor other Management Accountants when required
Key Requirements:
  • CA qualification and relevant tertiary accounting qualification
  • At least five years’ relevant management accounting experience
  • Strong month-end, budgeting, forecasting and financial-modelling skills
  • Excellent analytical ability and commercial awareness
  • Experience partnering with senior managers in a large or complex organisation
  • The confidence to provide advice, challenge assumptions and influence decisions
  • Advanced Excel skills and experience with financial reporting systems
  • A continuous-improvement mindset and the ability to simplify complex information
  • Power BI dashboarding experience would be valuable. Experience with Oracle, Hyperion or another large budgeting and forecasting system would be advantageous
What’s on offer
  • Base salary of approximately $132,700
  • KiwiSaver contributions on top of base salary
  • Five weeks’ annual leave as opposed to 4 weeks
  • Medical, life, trauma and income-protection insurance
  • A senior role offering broad stakeholder exposure and opportunities to step up
Apply now or send your cv and cover letter to mel@alexanderjames.co.nz
